application.name: Factorio Lab
application.description: Angular-based production calculator for the game Factorio
application.backend: none — static single-page application, datasets copied in as assets, scenario state carried in the URL

gitLargeFileStorage.verification: each payload's sha256 must equal the oid recorded in the pointer stub it replaces; the per-path oids are listed in evidence/ingests/angular-factoriolab/lfs.json
gitLargeFileStorage.note: Without this step the production build fails at TS1136, because tsconfig.json enables resolveJsonModule and src/data/index.ts imports a pointer stub.

toolchain.packageManager: npm, package-lock.json lockfileVersion 1 (1609 entries, all integrity-hashed)

legacyCell.label: era-consistent with the Angular 10 support matrix; the repository itself pins no Node version

buildAsAcquired.reason: Git LFS pointer stubs parsed as JSON

nonclaims: This manifest records an acquired identity and one baseline attempt. It establishes no browser behavior, migration feasibility, pilot status, production readiness, certification, or legal approval.
